task: Implement the Arcanea Creature Atlas as a rights-aware encyclopedia, prompt library, contribution surface, and visual atlas UI.
audience: Arcanea creators, worldbuilders, contributors, and internal canon/review operators.
first_read: Creature Atlas is a searchable, rights-aware creature library with Arcanea-original visual variants and prompt packs.

references.label: Arcanea TASTE.md
references.reason: AI-lab premium interface, restrained mythology, no emoji icons, no fantasy-game chrome.

references.label: Arcanea World Repo Standard
references.reason: Repo-canonical content with derived app indexes.

references.label: U.S. Copyright fair use and derivative work guidance
references.reason: Protected-source entries must remain factual/reference-first and avoid exact generated likenesses.

direction.signature: A rights-aware creature graph where factual references produce distinct Arcanea visual variants.
system: Lucide icons for controls and labels
Abstract visual plates for prompt-ready entries
Generated bitmap creature assets remain blocked until QA approval

artifacts.notes: Desktop overview is readable, search-first, and shows the first atlas cards without overlap.
Mobile overview stacks cleanly with usable search controls and no text clipping in the first viewport.
Desktop detail separates reference, Arcanea variant, graph, provenance, and prompt sections clearly.
Mobile detail fits the header, metrics, and visual plate without incoherent overlap.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: Inspected desktop and mobile screenshots for overview and detail routes.

checks.name: generated-asset-gate
checks.evidence: No generated bitmap creature art was approved in this slice; entries are prompt-ready only.

score.notes: Strong utility, hierarchy, and rights clarity. Weakest element is that visual plates are abstract placeholders until generated creature assets pass QA.

known_risks: Approved generated creature images still need the full L99 generation, critic, and visual QA loop.
Global app typecheck is currently blocked by unrelated Genesis route errors.
The seed corpus contains 12 entries; Genesis 100 expansion remains backlog.
